title: Filtrous MCP Catalog Server
description: Search Filtrous lab-filtration products by spec, get prices, and request quotes from your AI agent.
summary: Search Filtrous lab-filtration products by spec, get prices, and request quotes from your AI agent.
offersHint: Search Filtrous lab-filtration products by spec, get prices, and request quotes from your AI agent. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://filtrous-mcp-catalog.filtrous.workers.dev/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key - required ONLY for get_price_and_lead_time and request_quote. Catalog search and product details work without it. Request a free key: support@filtrous.com

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer API key - required ONLY for get_price_and_lead_time and request_quote. Catalog search and product details work without it. Request a free key: support@filtrous.com

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search the Filtrous catalog by free text and/or spec terms (e.g. '0.22 micron PES syringe filter'). Returns matching products with title, handle, SKU, product_type, tags, price, and availability. Open tool — no API key required.

toolsPreview.name: get_product_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for one product by its handle: variants, SKUs, options, prices, images, and spec metafields. Open tool — no API key required.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_and_lead_time
toolsPreview.description: Get current price, availability, and (when permitted) stock for a SKU. KEYED tool — requires a valid API key. Tier pricing and lead time are placeholders until the Acumatica sync ships.

toolsPreview.name: request_quote
toolsPreview.description: Submit a quote request for one or more SKUs with buyer contact info. KEYED tool — requires a valid API key. Sales follows up out-of-band.
